+# Postmortem: BooklogrApiLatencyP99High
+
+## Root Cause
+Commit `cb2c088c66cdf9c92d6f0621a0bce775ed9d41bb` ("Schema cleanup: drop unused books title index") introduced Alembic migration `e2a9d4c1b6f8_drop_unused_books_title_index.py`, which dropped the composite index `ix_books_owner_lower_title` on the `books` table (`owner_id`, `lower(title)`).
+
+The `/v1/books` endpoint (`get_books` in `api/routes/books.py`) filters records by `owner_id` and orders results by `func.lower(getattr(Books, sort_by))` (where `title` is default). Without `ix_books_owner_lower_title`, book listing queries performed unindexed full table scans and sorts, increasing p99 latency to ~495ms (exceeding the 300ms SLA threshold).
+
+## Evidence
+- Prometheus metric `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, path) (rate(flask_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[1m])))` showed `/v1/books` route latency at ~0.495s.
+- `git log` showed recent commit `cb2c088c66cdf9c92d6f0621a0bce775ed9d41bb` dropping `ix_books_owner_lower_title`.
+- `api/routes/books.py` line 265 shows queries ordering by `func.lower(getattr(Books, sort_by))` while filtering on `Books.owner_id`.
+
+## Changes Made
+- Removed migration `migrations/versions/e2a9d4c1b6f8_drop_unused_books_title_index.py` (reverting commit `cb2c088c66cdf9c92d6f0621a0bce775ed9d41bb`), preserving the `ix_books_owner_lower_title` composite index on `(owner_id, lower(title))`.
